summary: MaintSiteProfile is a web page and backend code module for maintaining site profiles in HSPnet, composed of ASP.NET WebForms, C#, designer files, and JavaScript. It provides a multi-tabbed interface for site data entry, viewing, document management, contacts, recruitment, prerequisites, closures, history, and SSO settings. The module integrates complex business rules, field validations, and conditional tab/field access based on user roles and site attributes.
purpose: To allow authorized users to edit and view site profiles, manage site-related documents, contacts, recruitment information, prerequisites, closures, and history; all within a permissioned, multi-tabbed UI. The module supports both read-only and editable modes, leverages reusable user controls, and enforces business rules governing user access and editing.

workflows.name: Site Profile Tab Navigation
steps: On page load, determine the active tab by query string or database state.
Enable/disable tabs based on user role and UseSSO/UseRecruitment flags.
Link child user controls for each tab for viewing/editing site data.
DataBind relevant controls for the selected tab.
Upon data update (edit/save), propagate session and site state.

workflows.name: Site Profile Editing
steps: Check editability: allowed if QES or PC Local Admin with no ServiceUser, or System Admin, or site agency matches user agency.
Show FormView in Edit or ReadOnly mode based on permissions.
Allow edit/save/cancel for fields if editable; otherwise, restrict.

workflows.name: Recruitment Contact Workflow
steps: Display recruitment contact info (name, email, phone, title) if exists.
Allow edit of recruitment contact via dropdown and edit/save actions.
Conditionally render recruitment panel if UseRecruitment = 1.

workflows.name: Document Management Workflow
steps: Enable document tab only if not using AlternateDatabase.
Bind document grid and control document access based on user type.
Allow add/delete/search for site documents via stored procedures.

workflows.name: Requirement Workflow
steps: Enable/disable prerequisite tab based on user role.
Bind grid for requirements; allow add/edit/delete/search.
Handle subdisciplines via dropdown and related validation.

workflows.name: Closures Workflow
steps: Display/enable closures tab based on site state and user role.
Bind closures grid and restrict access if StudentUser or not SystemAdmin.

workflows.name: History Workflow
steps: Bind site history grid if not StudentUser and not using AlternateDatabase.
Restrict access otherwise.

workflows.name: SSO Settings Workflow
steps: Enable SSO tab only if UseSSO=1 and user is SystemAdministrator.
Bind SSO settings user control.

business_rules: Tabs are enabled/disabled based on flags like UseSSO, UseRecruitment, user role, and alternate database status.
Profile is editable only for authorized roles and conditions: QES, PC Local Admin with no ServiceUser, System Admin, or site agency equals user agency.
Placement coordinators can edit sites only if no user services exist.
Receiving users or sysadmins cannot edit sites in their own agency unless explicitly allowed.
Recruitment contact is visible only if UseRecruitment is set and contact exists.
Document and requirement access restricted if StudentUser or not ReceivingUser/PlacementCoordinator; SystemAdmin bypasses.
ServiceUser existence restricts edits for other roles.
validations: Requirement description must not be empty if 'OtherRequirementCodeID' is selected.
Start date must be less than max allowed date.
End date must be less than max allowed date.
Start date must be before or equal to end date.
If 'AllowAllDisciplines' is checked, at least one included discipline must be selected (Document tab).
conditions: Tab enabled/disabled based on UseRecruitment, UseSSO, StudentUser, AlternateDatabase.
Screen editability determined by user role, site agency, and QES/ServiceUser flags.
Recruitment tab is enabled only if UseRecruitment=1 and contact exists.
Document tab enabled if not using AlternateDatabase.
History tab enabled if not StudentUser and not using AlternateDatabase.
system_behavior: Multi-tab UI renders child user controls only for the currently active tab.
Controls show/hide and enable/disable based on session state and site attributes.
Page messages (error/warning) are processed and displayed via panels.
All controls/data are re-bound on navigation or update.
Tab headers append 'Exists_Flag' if corresponding data exists.
FormView switches modes based on permission.
dependencies: User controls: SiteWebsites.ascx, SiteDetails.ascx, SiteProfileClosures.ascx, SiteRequirements.ascx, SiteDocuments.ascx, SiteContacts.ascx, SiteRecruitmentResources.ascx, SiteRecruitmentOpportunities.ascx, SiteProfileHistory.ascx, Security/SsoSettings.ascx
Stored procedures for site searches, document management, recruitment, requirements, contacts, closures.
JavaScript for UI validation and tab/page behaviors.
exceptions: Tab navigation attempts to restricted tabs revert to the default profile tab.
Edit attempts without proper permission are rejected.
Recruitment/Document/Requirement tabs disabled or hidden if not allowed or if using AlternateDatabase.
ServiceUser existence blocks edits for PlacementCoordinator and LocalAdministrator.
content_gaps: Internal logic of user controls, stored procedures, and complete field list definitions not fully documented.
Exact business rule details for some custom workflow branches may require code review of referenced controls (ascx) and backend C#.
